title: Swiping the Settings sheet shut mid-erase leaves the erase stuck: its words never show, the new-user questions never restart, and later erases from another device are ignored until relaunch
evidence: Done by PR 1284 (f8e0e62bf), then PR 1363 (9962dc9ac): DataEraser.Phase is one union with erasingClosed and held (DataEraser.swift:36-48), and the Settings sheet refuses a swipe while erasing (RecordSection.swift:57 interactiveDismissDisabled(eraser.erasing)); pinned by DataEraserTests.testAnEraseThatEndsAfterSettingsClosedIsHeldForRootView_US25_AC16d. Was: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/DataEraser.swift:28-33 (erasing, startsOver, awaitingDismissal); MyData/RecordSection.swift:34-35,56-61,83-89 (confirming, outcome); Sync/CloudSync.swift:35 (a second erasing); MyDataView.swift:103-105 sheet has no interactiveDismissDisabled; RootView.swift:115,206.
